author: blu
body: RFC 3986 section 2. This chapter parsed URIs from the day it was written and could not produce one safely, because there was no percent-encoder in it or anywhere else: `uri-encode` was CALLED by `Net chapter OAuthClient` and DEFINED nowhere, which is why that chapter has never compiled. `url-encode` is not the missing name either -- it is the HTML plug's JS-bridge builtin for browser apps and reaches nothing on bare metal.
